create_capture_worker_process: create a CaptureWorker subprocess to handle CV2 VideoCapture frame reading and shared memory communication
open_capture_with_backend: open a camera or video source using the appropriate CV2 backend like V4L2 or GStreamer
read_capture_frame: read and process a frame from the capture source with resize, flip, and BGR to RGB conversion
setup_worker_with_extensions: setup a capture worker with shared memory, blank frame, and PoseVisExtension instances
cleanup_capture_worker: cleanup and release the capture worker resources including VideoCapture and extensions
